description: This file defines the User class within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. The class manages user session attributes, authentication status, user details (ID, role, employee number), flash messages, and access rights, encapsulating session handling logic for user authentication and authorization.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A singleton class that manages user session attributes, authentication status, user properties, and flash messages within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the User class, creating it if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current session object from the dependency container.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a named attribute in the user session.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a named attribute from the user session, with an optional default value.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a named attribute exists in the user session.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a named attribute from the user session.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all session attributes.

methods.name: addFlash
methods.description: Adds a flash message of a specific type to the session.

methods.name: getFlash
methods.description: Retrieves flash messages of a specific type from the session.

methods.name: hasFlash
methods.description: Checks if there are flash messages of a specific type.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is currently authenticated.

methods.name: setIsAuthenticated
methods.description: Sets the authentication status of the user.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Gets the user ID.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID.

methods.name: getUserRoleId
methods.description: Gets the user role ID.

methods.name: setUserRoleId
methods.description: Sets the user role ID.

methods.name: getUserRoleName
methods.description: Gets the name of the user's role.

methods.name: setUserRoleName
methods.description: Sets the user's role name.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Gets the employee number.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number.

methods.name: getUserLastModified
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of when the user information was last modified.

methods.name: setUserLastModified
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of when the user information was last modified.

methods.name: getHasAdminAccess
methods.description: Checks if the user has administrative access.

methods.name: setHasAdminAccess
methods.description: Sets the user's administrative access status.
